subject: Spin off games
author: ZombieTron
body:
Neither Legends or Dominator were developed by Criterion Games.

Burnout Legends is basically Burnout 3: Takedown for the handheld market, and Burnout: Dominator was a stop gap filler for PS2 and PSP. We do have quite a few articles about Burnout: Dominator.

If you have any questions about any of the Burnout games please let us know and we will see if we can answer them for you.

Or.. if you want to write any content about any Burnout titles please do so in your Blog, if it's great we will publish it as a featured article! 🙂
